recognize_zh: 抹片中的肥大細胞呈圓形、顆粒滿布且看起來很成熟；切片可見大片圓形細胞聚集，核圓居中、細胞質豐富淡染，tryptase 陽性、CD30 陽性而 CD25 僅少數陽性，符合分化良好型全身性肥大細胞增生症（WDSM）。
features: Aspirate (A): increased round, mature-appearing mast cells densely packed with dark purple metachromatic granules; no spindle forms
Core (B): normocellular marrow adjacent to bony trabecula with a large paratrabecular aggregate of pale cells
Core high power (C): sheets of round cells with central round nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, resembling epithelioid cells
IHC (D): strong diffuse cytoplasmic tryptase positivity
IHC (E, F): weak membranous CD30 staining (E) and granular CD25 staining limited to a minor subset (F)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased round, well-granulated, mature-appearing mast cells without spindle morphology or hypogranularity. The core biopsy is normocellular with large aggregates of round cells with central nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm; at high power these cells lack spindling. The aggregates are strongly tryptase-positive, show CD30 expression, and CD25 is present only in a minor subset. In the absence of KIT D816V and with CD2 negativity, the findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis, well-differentiated morphology.

ddx.vs: Conventional SM shows spindle, hypogranular mast cells with strong CD25 (and often CD2) expression and KIT D816V, unlike the round CD25-weak cells here.
Reactive mast cells are scattered singly without dense multifocal aggregates of 15 or more cells and serum tryptase is not markedly elevated.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or epithelioid histiocytic lesion
ddx.vs: The pale epithelioid sheets on H&E could mimic carcinoma or histiocytes, but tryptase and CD117 positivity with cytokeratin/CD163 negativity establish mast cell lineage.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: Mast cells in PDGFRA-rearranged neoplasms are usually spindled, CD25-positive and accompanied by marked eosinophilia with FIP1L1::PDGFRA.

stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E; IHC: tryptase, CD30, CD25
